<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<title>Law & Order Situation Assessment — Uttar Pradesh Police</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@700&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root {
    --crimson: #991B1B;
    --navy: #0F172A;
    --gold: #D97706;
    --bg: #FAFAF9;
    --card-bg: #FFFFFF;
    --border: #E7E5E4;
    --text: #1C1917;
    --muted: #78716C;
    --pos: #15803D;
    --neg: #B91C1C;
    --neu: #64748B;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  .page {
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 36px;
    page-break-after: always;
  }
  .govt-header {
    text-align: center;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--crimson);
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .emblem-title {
    font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
    color: var(--crimson);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .dept-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .report-heading {
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  }
  .sec-pill {
    display: inline-block;
    background: #FEF2F2;
    color: var(--crimson);
    border: 1px solid #FECACA;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 3px 12px;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  .stat-deck {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .stat-box {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-top: 3px solid var(--crimson);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    text-align: center;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .stat-box .val {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--navy);
  }
  .stat-box .lbl {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .panel {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 18px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .panel-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: var(--crimson);
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #F5F5F4;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .bar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .bar-label {
    width: 90px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 600;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .bar-track {
    flex: 1;
    background: #F5F5F4;
    border-radius: 3px;
    height: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }
  .bar-count {
    width: 45px;
    text-align: right;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--navy);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .tag-cloud {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .tag-chip {
    background: #F5F5F4;
    border: 1px solid #E7E5E4;
    color: var(--navy);
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  th {
    text-align: left;
    background: #FAFAF9;
    color: var(--navy);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
  }
  td {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .official-seal {
    text-align: right;
    margin-top: 24px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
  }
</style>
</head>
